activity_summary: Clearing up the tiring-house after the sharers' vote, you, John Heminges, and Augustine Phillips went over the three dates (26 July, 25 August, 17 July) with no road sum written, Kemp's lone dissent, and August's fit for the pages before walking to the Jackdaw for Richard's birthday supper.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Acknowledged Kemp's point on hired men's wages and carried the pearwood glass for Richard.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Recapped the three dates with no sum under them and locked the sheet away before the Jackdaw.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Noted Kemp left still muttering about Kent and said he saved his throat for tonight's singing.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Walked out still standing against the closure and talking of Kent.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Pressed William to own aloud that August suits the pages.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Twenty-seventh birthday supper waiting at the Jackdaw.

entities.name: The Theatre
entities.context: Mentioned in Tiring-house exchange after the summer closure vote

entities.name: the pearwood glass
entities.context: Mentioned in Tiring-house exchange after the summer closure vote

facets.activity: Talked over the August vote with Heminges and Phillips

quotes.speaker: John Heminges
quotes.text: A wagon eats coin on wet days and dry days alike. An empty yard costs us nothing till we open it.

quotes.speaker: William Shakespeare
quotes.text: August suits the pages better than it suits the road, and I am not pretending otherwise.
